fullContentHtml:
CWC Assistant Manager & Junior Executive Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Central Warehousing Corporation (CWC) has released the notification for the post of Assistant Manager & Junior Executive. This recruitment has been issued for 327 posts. Online applying process for CWC Assistant Manager & Junior Executive Recruitment 2026 has started from 17 October 2026 & the candidates can apply till 15 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for CWC Assistant Manager & Junior Executive Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 17 October 2026
  • Last Date : 15 November 2026
  • Fees Payment Last Date : 15 November 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1350/-
  • SC, ST, PH, ESM : Rs. 500/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 500/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

CWC Assistant Manager & Junior Executive Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
